scope: Gmail opens and reads your mail again, and numbered steps in the Word guide start at 1.

topics.title: Clear Gmail sign-in messages
details: Gmail sign-in now stops after five minutes if it does not finish. Before, the app could wait with no sound.
If you press Cancel on the Google page, the app tells you and says how to try again.
Google may show a box for each permission. If a box is not checked, the app tells you to sign in again and check every box.

topics.title: Gmail inbox
details: In the last two versions, a Gmail inbox could fail to open. It now opens again.
The app still gets long lists quickly when it can. If that does not work, it gets messages one at a time, as before.

topics.title: Guide numbering
details: In the Word copy of the guide, each list of steps now starts at 1. Before, the numbers ran on from the last list.
The Word copy of the release notes is fixed the same way.

topics.title: Browser extension
details: The browser extension did not change. You do not need to reload it.
